title: Task Implementer Input Contract
description: Defines all input parameters required to run task-implementer skill autonomously. Receives one atomic task object from issue-analyzer plus workspace context. Registered as contract `task-implementer-input`: validate a request with `keryx skills contracts validate <request.json> --schema task-implementer-input`.

task.description: The atomic task to implement, as issue-analyzer decomposed it.

task_id.description: Unique task identifier. `fix-<n>` is legal because orchestrator-prompt.md Step 4 builds exactly that for a fix round; the pattern was `^task-\d+$`, so every fix dispatch this skill documents was one the contract would have refused.

dependencies.description: Task IDs this task depends on (already completed)

description.description: Full description of what to implement

target_files.description: File paths to modify or create

acceptance_criteria.description: Criteria that must be met for task to be considered complete

context.description: Relevant code context: key types, function signatures, patterns

existing_tests.description: Paths to existing test files (empty array if none)

existing_stories.description: Paths to existing story files (empty array if none)

module_patterns.description: Notes on how similar code is written in the module

test_case_specs.description: RED-phase test stubs already written and committed by tests-creator. Present => TDD Mode (SKILL.md Phase 4.0): the implementer makes these GREEN and writes no new tests.

test_files.description: Test files that must be failing when the task starts

run_command.description: Command that runs exactly those test files

workspace.description: Workspace context managed by the orchestrator.

codebase_path.description: Absolute path to the repository root

branch.description: Feature branch to work on (already created and checked out by orchestrator)

issue_number.description: Optional real GitHub issue number for commit references; omit for description-based tasks and flows

job_name.description: Job package slug, when the dispatch came from job-orchestrator. Phase 6.1 records its result against this name with `keryx job document <job_name> --type implementation-report --file <path>`; absent, Phase 6.1 skips the file write.

context_path.description: Job context document read at the start of Phase 2, e.g. .metaproject/jobs/<job_name>/ai/context.md

fix_context.description: Present only for fix tasks dispatched from review loop.

file.description: File path where the issue was found

original_task_ids.description: The tasks that introduced the findings. Plural because a fix round collects findings across a whole wave — orchestrator-prompt.md Step 4 has always sent an array, while this field was named `original_task_id` and typed as one string, so the two could never agree.

iteration.description: Fix iteration number. Three, the same bound `flow-orchestrator`, `job-orchestrator` and SKILL.md Phase 5.4 carry and `src/gdskills/round-bound.test.ts` pins; it was 2 here, a fourth disagreeing repair bound.

automation.description: Controls for autonomous execution. This object is the ONLY definition of the automation settings — SKILL.md points here rather than restating the defaults.

skip_confirmation.description: Must be true for autonomous mode

verify_stories.description: Build storybook to verify stories compile

max_self_fix_attempts.description: Max attempts to fix verification failures. Bounded at 3, not 5: SKILL.md Phase 5.4 states an absolute "Maximum 3 self-fix attempts per verification step" and cites the evidence for it, so a request asking for 4 was asking for something the skill refuses to do.

commit_message_style.description: Commit format. One value: SKILL.md Phase 4.5 documents the conventional form and no other.
